snippet.title: Wabisabi Sushi Derby - Official Release Window Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the release window trailer for Wabisabi Sushi Derby, the first-ever sushi racing simulation game developed by Itamae Studio. Become a sushi chef and raise rambunctious, pixelated sushi to race around the sushi restaurant. Select from multiple types of sushi and cheer at the perfect moment to trigger a speed boost, and avoid hungry customers’ looming chopsticks that can end the race in an instant. Wabisabi Sushi Derby will be available on PC in spring 2026.
